source: universal practice_set.css bundled in Base Practice PM Starter; Framework copy is a byte-identical mirror

layout.h1: short Framework-defined resource title; navy text, 15pt, transparent background, 2px navy horizontal rule underneath
layout.visible_question_number: inline as first character/text via qnum
layout.visible_metadata: question number only; hidden data-bank-id allowed

workspace.utilities: ws-10 through ws-960 in 10px steps plus ws-25
workspace.normal_build_rule: Ship every ordinary Practice problem with ws-25 initially; teacher may manually bump individual problems later. Standard Algebra CYU uses no per-question workspace.

figures.rule: Use ps-figure/ps-diagram wrappers so deployed CSS sizing and keep-together rules fire. Copy finalized Bank figure bytes; do not generate Practice visuals. Do not emit visible decorative figcaptions/titles.

tables.two_column_layout: centered compact table, min-width 2.35in, 50/50 columns, max-width 100%
tables.rule: Use compact-table + half-col for ordinary two-column data tables; preserve canonical cell content.

css_change_rule: practice_set.css is the UNIVERSAL Practice stylesheet across courses. The Base Practice Starter copy is canonical; each course Framework carries a byte-identical mirror. Ordinary Practice builds link to deployed shared CSS and do not package or redesign it.

cyu.layout: six questions in 3 rows x 2 columns
